title: Blue Fashion Designer
description: A blue-skinned woman with horns and red eyes sits in an ornate dressing room, wearing a striped blouse, grey capelet, pearl necklace, white gloves, and black shoes while holding a peacock feather fan. She gazes at her reflection in a large ornate mirror, surrounded by fashion sketches, an open book, a teacup, and pinned designs on a purple wall.
prompt: A blue-skinned humanoid woman with small black horns, red eyes and blue facial markings sits elegantly in a dimly lit Victorian-style dressing room, wearing a dark striped blouse with a grey capelet, pearl necklace, white gloves and long black skirt, holding a peacock feather fan, looking at her reflection in a large ornate silver mirror, fashion sketches and drawings scattered on the vanity table with a teacup, open book on a nearby chaise, pinned designs on purple walls, atmospheric lighting, realistic painting style
